$comment: Manipulating Mastermind (OS Rune model, wiki 2026-11) with GAME_BREAKDOWN §13's Pokémon twist. Psychic = our ball grab (no OS equivalent: short hold, slowed, any hit drops it; throw ≤ 1.2× Strike). Teleport = Shadow Swap (11 s, swap places, an Unstable Anomaly pillar where you left: 200+100 % dmg, 250+125 % player KB, 1290+185 % core KB). Future Sight = Rune's Banish (40 s, 1.75 s banish, 270+130 % dmg) delivered as a telegraphed delayed area. Player knockback = OS × 1.875; power % → powerRatio.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.desc: Grab the ball from up to 300 away and hold it for 0.6 s (slowed; any hit drops it). Press again to throw it. If you don't, it's tossed forward.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.desc: Swap places with the ally nearest your aim (up to 900 away), leaving a psychic burst where you stood.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.desc: Mark an area. After 1 s it erupts, banishing enemies inside for 1.75 s and blasting the ball.
